name: token-burner
description: DSH-inspired ambient token telemetry for Angelus. The floating flame follows the selected Session's authoritative usage projection and turns settled token deltas into a decaying visual burn rate. Frontend-only; no Python entrypoint and no model/tool calls.

settings_schema.title: Telemetry sample interval (ms)
settings_schema.description: How often the plugin refreshes Session usage and run state. This is a projection refresh, not a model request.

settings_schema.title: Flame decay (ms)
settings_schema.description: How long a settled token burst remains visible before fading.

settings_schema.title: Full-flame reference rate
settings_schema.description: Visual reference tok/s used by the logarithmic intensity mapping. It does not alter usage accounting.

settings_schema.title: Show cumulative tokens
settings_schema.description: Display the selected Session's authoritative cumulative total.

settings_schema.title: Show peak burn rate
settings_schema.description: Display the largest visual burn-rate impulse observed since the current Session was selected.

settings_schema.title: Keep a pilot flame while running
settings_schema.description: Keep a small flame visible while a run is active even between settled token updates.
